tools.name: lookup_keyword
tools.description: Get Google monthly search volume, CPC, competition and similar keywords (with their volumes) for one keyword in one country. Use for keyword research, sizing demand, comparing topics, or picking SEO/content targets.

tools.name: lookup_keywords
tools.description: Get monthly search volume, CPC, competition and similar keywords for up to 25 keywords in one country at once. Prefer this over repeated lookup_keyword calls when comparing or prioritizing a keyword list.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show which seodata.dev plan this connection uses and how many keyword lookups are left today and this month.
